description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes for managing lists of strings, including sorted and unsorted variants, with operations such as add, remove, sort, split, and lookup.

methods.name: string_list_init_nodup
methods.description: Initialize a string_list with no duplication of strings.

methods.name: string_list_init_dup
methods.description: Initialize a string_list with strdup() of strings.

methods.name: filter_string_list
methods.description: Filter list items based on a predicate function.

methods.name: string_list_clear
methods.description: Free all resources associated with a string_list.

methods.name: string_list_clear_func
methods.description: Apply a custom clear function to each util pointer in the list.

methods.name: string_list_setlen
methods.description: Set the length of the list without reallocating.

methods.name: for_each_string_list
methods.description: Apply a function to each item in the list.

methods.name: string_list_remove_empty_items
methods.description: Remove empty string items from the list.

methods.name: string_list_has_string
methods.description: Check if a string exists in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_find_insert_index
methods.description: Find insertion index to maintain sorted order.

methods.name: string_list_insert
methods.description: Insert a string into a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_remove
methods.description: Remove a string from a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_lookup
methods.description: Lookup a string in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_remove_duplicates
methods.description: Remove duplicate entries in a sorted list.

methods.name: string_list_append
methods.description: Append a string to an unsorted list, copying if needed.

methods.name: string_list_append_nodup
methods.description: Append a string to an unsorted list without copying.

methods.name: string_list_sort
methods.description: Sort an unsorted list.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_has_string
methods.description: Check if a string exists in an unsorted list.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_lookup
methods.description: Lookup a string in an unsorted list.

methods.name: unsorted_string_list_delete_item
methods.description: Delete an item from an unsorted list.

methods.name: string_list_split
methods.description: Split a string into substrings and append to list.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place
methods.description: Split a string in-place into substrings.

methods.name: string_list_split_f
methods.description: Split a string with flags, appending substrings.

methods.name: string_list_split_in_place_f
methods.description: In-place split with flags.
